title: Semi-Hardcore
description: Ever thought Hardcore was too Hard and Normal Survival was just too easy? Well this is the Datapack for you!
body:
**Hey, this Datapack probably has some bugs and is missing some polish here and there if the demand is large enough i will probably come back to this Project and make it compatible with 1.20.5+ and (if necessary) add more Polish to it**

# Mechanic Overview
- **Multiplayer Friendly!**
- **_Should_ work on version 1.16-1.19 (1.20 not Tested)**
- **3. Lives per Player/World!**
- **Craftable Revives! (Note: Multiplayer Only)**
- **No new Items!**
- **Simple and Lag Free!**

# The Revive System
Once crafted the revive will dissapear and a valid player will be looked for if noone is found you wont get the items back, Sorry bud #NOREFUNDS

**Revives are _not_ Storeable since they get used up directly after Crafting**
